LayoutCoupledRotateAlign.variant_right_top: Rotate the middle rectangle 90° clockwise, then align all three rectangles by their top edges.
LayoutCoupledRotateAlign.variant_left_left: Rotate the middle rectangle 90° counter-clockwise, then align all three rectangles by their left edges.
LayoutCoupledRotateAlign.variant_right_bottom: Rotate the middle rectangle 90° clockwise, then align all three rectangles by their bottom edges.
LayoutCoupledRotateAlign.variant_left_right: Rotate the middle rectangle 90° counter-clockwise, then align all three rectangles by their right edges.

LayoutCoupledGroupLifecycle.variant_flip_horizontal: Group all three rectangles together into a single grouped shape, flip the group horizontally, then ungroup the grouped rectangles into individual shapes.
LayoutCoupledGroupLifecycle.variant_flip_vertical: Group all three rectangles together into a single grouped shape, flip the group vertically, then ungroup the grouped rectangles into individual shapes.
LayoutCoupledGroupLifecycle.variant_rotate: Group all three rectangles together into a single grouped shape, rotate the group 90° clockwise, then ungroup the grouped rectangles into individual shapes.

LayoutCoupledWrapPosition.variant_square_top_center: Apply square wrapping to the cross shape (text wraps around the cross's rectangular bounding box), then position it at the top-center of the page, using the Position preset (within default page margins).
LayoutCoupledWrapPosition.variant_tight_top_left: Apply tight wrapping to the cross shape (text follows closely along the cross's edges), then position it at the top-left corner of the page, using the Position preset (within default page margins).

LayoutCoupledPositionAlignMulti.variant_bottom_right_align_right: Position the first rectangle at the bottom-right corner of the page using the Position preset (within default page margins), then align all three rectangles' right edges to the rightmost edge among them.
LayoutCoupledPositionAlignMulti.variant_top_center_align_top: Position the first rectangle at the top-center of the page using the Position preset (within default page margins), then align all three rectangles' top edges to the topmost edge among them.

LayoutCoupledMultiStep.variant_rotate_align_distribute: Rotate the middle rectangle 90° clockwise, align all three rectangles by their top edges, then distribute all three rectangles evenly horizontally with equal spacing between them.
LayoutCoupledMultiStep.variant_group_flip_ungroup_distribute: Group all three rectangles together into a single grouped shape, flip the group horizontally, ungroup the grouped rectangles into individual shapes, then distribute all three rectangles evenly horizontally with equal spacing between them.
